rulesync.label: Node.js
rulesync.setup: rulesync runs via `npx rulesync`, which needs Node.js. Bob normally ships it; if it is missing, install Node from nodejs.org.

mcp-builder.label: Node.js
mcp-builder.setup: Scaffolding an MCP server needs Node.js and npm. Bob normally ships it; if it is missing, install Node from nodejs.org.

drawio-skill.label: draw.io desktop (for rendering and export)
drawio-skill.setup: drawio-skill renders and exports diagrams with the draw.io desktop app. Install draw.io Desktop, then click Recheck.

drawio-skill.label: Graphviz (optional, better auto-layout)
drawio-skill.setup: Optional. Graphviz improves auto-layout for large diagrams (e.g. brew install graphviz), then Recheck.
